magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'BABARSAV' save tag, EEPROM record 0 (rev8-logical domain)

fields.name: save_signature
fields.description: Save tag 'BABARSAV' occupying EEPROM record 0 (first 8-byte record)
fields.evidence: Rev8-logical bytes 0..8 of samples/baseline.sav decode to ASCII 'BABARSAV' (raw bytes are block-reversed 'VASRABAB'). EEPROM record R/W in FUN_0803f3d4 (reads 4 halfwords/record) and FUN_0803f498 (writes 4 halfwords/record) via DMA3 helper FUN_0803f354 to DAT_0d000000; game file layer opens the save through FUN_0806d130 -> FUN_0802706c -> FUN_08030568 -> FUN_080303e4 -> FUN_080324a8 -> FUN_0803f00c.

fields.name: save_data_record_01_word_0
fields.description: Halfword 0 of EEPROM data record 1 (first save-data word after the signature record)
fields.evidence: FUN_0803f3d4 stores the 4 received halfwords of one EEPROM record descending from param_2+6 (save-file offsets record*8+6 down to record*8+0), and FUN_0803f498 serializes 4 halfwords ascending from param_2, so file offset 8 maps 1:1 to RAM save-struct byte 8. Record access is wrapped by FUN_0803f650 (read via FUN_0803f484, verify via FUN_0803f5f8, 3 retries). Transport is DMA3 helper FUN_0803f354 to DAT_0d000000.

fields.name: save_data_record_01_word_1
fields.evidence: Same 4-halfword record layout as save_data_record_01_word_0: FUN_0803f3d4 writes the second received halfword to param_2+4 (save-file offsets record*8+2..record*8+4); FUN_0803f498 serializes param_2[1] as the second halfword. Verified by FUN_0803f5f8 which compares 4 halfwords per record. DMA via FUN_0803f354 to DAT_0d000000.

fields.name: save_data_record_01_word_2
fields.evidence: Same 4-halfword record layout: FUN_0803f3d4 stores the third received halfword at param_2+2 (save-file offsets record*8+4..record*8+6); FUN_0803f498 serializes param_2[2] third. Read path FUN_0803f484 and verify path FUN_0803f5f8 both move 4 halfwords per record through FUN_0803f354 DMA to DAT_0d000000.

fields.name: save_data_record_01_word_3
fields.evidence: Same 4-halfword record layout: FUN_0803f3d4 stores the fourth received halfword at param_2+0 (save-file offsets record*8+6..record*8+8); FUN_0803f498 serializes param_2[3] last (transmitted first on the wire, confirming the in-order byte mapping). Wrapper FUN_0803f650 retries the 8-byte record R/W up to 3 times via FUN_0803f484/FUN_0803f5f8.

fields.name: save_data_record_02_dword_0
fields.description: Lower 32-bit word of EEPROM data record 2 (halfwords 0-1 of the record)
fields.evidence: EEPROM record 2 (save-file offsets 16..24) handled as 4 halfwords by FUN_0803f3d4 (read) and FUN_0803f498 (write); game-level buffered reads arrive through FUN_0806cae4 -> FUN_0802716c and writes through FUN_0806cd20 -> FUN_080271d8, with device I/O via FUN_0803f094 (read) and FUN_0803f188 (write). DMA transport FUN_0803f354 to DAT_0d000000 preserves byte order.

fields.name: save_data_record_02_dword_1
fields.description: Upper 32-bit word of EEPROM data record 2 (halfwords 2-3 of the record)
fields.evidence: EEPROM record 2 upper half (save-file offsets 20..24): FUN_0803f3d4 deposits these bytes from the third/fourth received halfwords at param_2+2/param_2+0 equivalently ordered; FUN_0803f498 emits them from the same RAM offsets. File-layer access FUN_0806cae4/FUN_0806cd20, device layer FUN_0803f094/FUN_0803f188, DMA FUN_0803f354 to DAT_0d000000.

fields.name: save_data_record_03_payload
fields.description: Full 8-byte payload of EEPROM data record 3 (four halfwords as stored)
fields.evidence: EEPROM record 3 (save-file offsets 24..32) is one atomic 8-byte record: FUN_0803f5f8 verifies exactly 4 halfwords per record and FUN_0803f650 rewrites the record when verification fails; FUN_0803f498 writes the record MSB-first-on-wire but byte-ordered 1:1 with the RAM buffer. Transport FUN_0803f354 (0x44-halfword DMA) to DAT_0d000000.
